svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The three laws differ in one place only: where the extra term is added.
ILOS puts it INSIDE the arctan, so it looks like more cross-track error. ALOS puts it OUTSIDE, so it looks like a rotated path.
Inside the arctan, a term is indistinguishable from more cross-track error — ILOS steers as if the vessel were 2.25 m further out.
Outside it, a term is indistinguishable from a rotated path — ALOS steers along a line tilted by the drift it estimated.
